title: OmniHuman 2.0
description: BytePlus OmniHuman 2.0 — the newest OmniHuman: animates the person (or character/pet) in an image to speak the input audio, with synchronized lips, expression, body motion and camera movement you can direct with a prompt. 720p; audio up to 120 seconds. Priced per second of the input audio, rounded UP to whole seconds, with a 4-second minimum (84 credits/second — e.g. a 12.4s clip bills as 13s, a 2.5s clip as 4s).

audio.description: The speech/audio to lip-sync (mp3, wav or ogg, up to 120 seconds, max 15 MB; under 4 seconds is billed as 4). A public audio URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

image.description: The subject to animate — a human face/portrait, character, or pet. 300-6000 px a side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2. A public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. jpg/png/webp.

prompt.description: Optional text prompt to direct the scene, gestures and camera movement (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish or Indonesian).
